truth: CORE-01 and CORE-03 remain closed as construction dependencies; CORE-02 remains preserved incomplete with Success Memory outstanding.
CORE-04A-D remain implemented stacked draft-PR evidence. CORE-04D is mergeable PR #26 at head 52303150d539733ab31b05f281e11d10c5e02130.
CORE-04E Execution Eligibility Evidence Gate is implemented on mergeable draft PR #27 at head b1646bba0425c511c629f13679d2b1b035c01479; hosted exact-head execution is UNOBSERVED.

Global reselection chose CORE-04F because exact authority, connectivity, current eligibility and execute-once identity still do not prevent a multi-step musical job from becoming half-applied after an intermediate failure.
CORE-04F is the only active increment. TransactionCoordinator is adapter-neutral and composes over CORE-04D OperationJournal; no DAW/provider adapter is active.

Transaction plans and ordered steps are immutable/fingerprinted and persisted in the canonical profile SQLite database before mutation. Whole-operation success/failure/UNKNOWN remains owned by OperationJournal.
A recovery snapshot bound to the exact transaction/operation is required before forward execution. Every successful step must satisfy its exact declared postcondition before the next step may run.
On known failure, changed compensatable steps are compensated in strict reverse order. No later forward step runs after failure.
Ambiguous mutation, compensation failure, non-compensatable changed state, callback ambiguity or ambiguous final receipt produces RECOVERY_REQUIRED/UNKNOWN instead of invented success or blind retry.

STEP_EXECUTION_STARTED and COMPENSATION_STARTED evidence is committed before adapter callbacks, so a process crash leaves durable exact-step recovery breadcrumbs. Registered/in-flight transactions are not blindly rerun.
Transaction history survives restart, normal Headquarters reopen validates plan/event integrity, and transaction events enter canonical Activity chronology.

A durable contract-compatible SQLite harness is green across success, reverse compensation, callback/identity faults, immutability, Activity and crash/restart breadcrumbs. Repository regressions are authored; exact-branch automated execution is not yet observed.
No concrete DAW/provider executor, scanner, credential, network transport, spend, team permission or UI undo implementation is included in CORE-04F.
Hosted exact-head execution is accepted only when observed and never inferred from authored tests or local harnesses.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
